`platejs` ### Bug Fixes - - Replace `useArrowPath` and its `BoardArrowPath` type in `platejs/board/react` with three components that draw an arrow inside its `BoardShape`. `BoardArrowPath` is an SVG `path` between the arrow's ends, `BoardArrowhead` is an SVG `g` that draws its children at the arrow's end, and `BoardArrowLabel` is a `div` centered on the arrow's middle. An arrow follows a moved, dragged or resized shape without a render. The components draw the straight arrow the board stores. ([`33eb625`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/33eb62505f0512f99da91ed324bf3a92a018db5c)) **Migration:** Copy the `board` registry item again with all its files, because the static arrow draws the head that `board-styles` exports as `ARROW_HEAD`. In your own arrow renderer, remove the `useArrowPath(element)` call and its early return, then draw the path and head in an SVG and the label beside it. A press picks an arrow only when it lands on one of the arrow's elements, so keep a wide transparent path with `pointerEvents="stroke"`: ```tsx
{props.children} ``` - - Keep a comment thread unavailable when a letter in a new style is typed where its deleted text crossed a style change, instead of letting that letter join the thread. ([`9e5dcae`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9e5dcae01c83cf9396ec9c43a8a0c86133d62dbc)) - - Add `fieldSubmission` and `readFieldAnswers` to `platejs/field`. `fieldSubmission(template, role, values, options?)` builds one role's submission from a record keyed by field name, so an app sends its own data without mapping names to ids. `readFieldAnswers(document, options?)` reads a saved document's answers back by role and name. Each answer is a `FieldAnswer` whose `kind` narrows its `value`, or one that names the problem `answer-conflict` or `name-conflict`. ([`13f3456`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/13f3456fc30e683a2e7fa400f537219900a39075)) - Add `startFieldValues(template, submissions, start, options?)` to `platejs/field`. It replays the roles that already submitted, as `applyFieldValues` does, and returns the filled document a role starts from, with each value `start` gives written on its field and on every other field of its name. A field `start` leaves out starts blank, even one with a default, and so does a field that skips or waits on a role that has not submitted. The person who fills keeps, changes or clears each starting value and submits it as their own answer. A `start` that gives one name two values is refused as `answer-conflict`. - - Add an optional `name` to fields. A name is a text that is not empty, has no space at either end, and holds no control character, line or paragraph separator or lone surrogate. Loading, `insert`, `update` and a raw write refuse any other name, and `applyFieldValues` refuses a template that holds one as `invalid-template` with problem `malformed`. HTML writes it as `data-field-name`, Markdown as a `name` attribute, and both drop a name the rule refuses while keeping the field. A paste, a duplicate and a table fill keep the name and give the copy a new `fieldId`. Word export drops it with the other settings, and its warning now reads "Word keeps each field answer and drops its name and settings." ([`3fa7e45`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/3fa7e458bcb68446ee4421114b8e4ed031149c72)) - Add `name-conflict` and `answer-conflict` to `FieldProblem`, which `read.field` and `read.fields` report. Fields of one role that share a name must share their kind, their options' values and their condition. Each field of a name whose fields differ reads `name-conflict`, and the same name in two roles never conflicts. Each field of a name whose fields hold different stored values reads `answer-conflict`, so an empty text and no value differ. A copied `field` component that maps every `FieldProblem` needs both keys. - `applyFieldValues` refuses a template whose fields of one role and name differ in settings as `invalid-template` with problem `name-conflict`. Once a role's submission applies, it refuses each name of that role whose fields hold different answers as `{ code: 'answer-conflict', fieldIds, name, role }`, with every field of the name in document order, unless the submission already refused a field of the name as `invalid-value`, `wrong-role`, `skipped` or `waiting`. A name whose required field the submission left out still gets `answer-conflict` beside `missing-required`. - Every `applyFieldValues` refusal that names a field also carries that field's `name` when it has one: `invalid-template`, `invalid-value`, `missing-required`, `skipped`, `waiting` and `wrong-role`. Code that switches over `FieldRefusal` and reads `fieldId` in a default branch needs an `answer-conflict` case, which has `fieldIds` instead. - `update` writes a `value`, a cleared one included, to every field of the role that shares the field's name, in the same commit and the same undo step, unless the name reads `name-conflict`. No other setting reaches the other fields. - Adding `name` changes the schema fingerprint of every editor with the field plugin. **Migration:** A saved document holds no names, so it fills by `fieldId` as before. What to change depends on how the app saves: - With a named schema, bump `schema.version`, record the old fingerprint under `sourceFingerprints`, and add a migration step that returns the document unchanged. - If the app's own schema declared a `name` property on fields, remove that declaration. Its migration step moves each stored value to a key of the app's own, or keeps it only where the app means one answer per name and the value passes the name rule. - With the default derived identity and saved `{ document, schema }` envelopes, the editor refuses the old envelope because its fingerprint no longer matches. Check that the stored fingerprint is the one the editor produced before this change, then open the document with its selection and save it again: ```ts const editor = createEditor({ initialSelection: envelope.selection, initialValue: envelope.document, plugins, }); ``` Name the schema from then on, as the editor guide's Schema identity section advises. - An app that saves the bare document changes nothing. - A populated Yjs room keeps the schema identity it was created with, so an editor with this version cannot join it. Convert the room's document, seed a new room with it, and move every writer to the new room. - - Add the eraser to `platejs/ink/react`. `setTool({ size, type: 'erase' })` removes each mark whose painted ink the eraser's path touches. One contact's removals undo as one step unless another edit, local or remote, lands between them. `InkTool` is now a union, so code that reads `tool.brush` checks `tool.type === 'draw'` first. ([`d4459c6`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/d4459c65e9556a9c082cfb4997da760b9a9409a5)) - - Add the lasso to `platejs/ink/react`. `setTool({ type: 'lasso' })` draws a loop that picks the marks with more than half their samples inside it, and its press focuses the Editable so the keys reach the pick. While the lasso is on, Backspace or Delete removes the picked marks in one undo step and Escape clears the pick. Keys with Alt, Control or Meta, input method keys and the repeats of a held key leave the pick alone. Any other tool and hiding ink clear the pick. An eraser or lasso contact now ends when its primary button lifts while another button stays down. ([`386eb10`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/386eb106088a769eb68486aa241748c844114ffe)) - - In `platejs/ink/react`, changing the Draw tool, hiding ink or turning the view read-only now ends the current pen or eraser contact at once, and a pen stroke that ends this way saves nothing more. Turning the view read-only turns the tool off, even when it turns back in the same batch. While ink is hidden, every press reaches the content. The pen and the eraser read the layer's position at each sample, so a removal that moves the layer leaves the next sample on the ink under the pointer. `setTool` returns false and keeps the current tool for a `size` that is not a finite number above 0, a brush `opacity` that is not a number above 0 and at most 1, or a brush `color` that is not a non-empty string. ([`e7e7ac4`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/e7e7ac4f72e10b64991d863374d0a83475b29d8d)) - - In `platejs/ink`, a mark drawn on a mention, or on another inline void, now shows its changed sign once that void is swapped for a different one or its properties change, instead of staying on the new one. A void's id and review marks don't count, so a mark on a suggested mention stays live when the suggestion is accepted. A mark saved before this change on a block that holds an inline void shows that sign too, because its saved copy has no record of the voids. ([`0274644`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/0274644f3fbfcef7555711eb693fd055ed698f34)) - - Type the node a `match` callback receives in a plugin's `tx.nodes.set` as `Element` instead of `any`. ([`257320a`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/257320aaba502b009feb4250b19dad6b0cc062d1)) - Paint each suggestion author in one color: `data-editor-authored-color` now holds the palette slot of the author whose change an element paints, and `suggestionColorOf` takes an author id ([`ca52412`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/ca52412f9df5b99ad82996fb3a0ab7dc5971fdd4)) `plitejs` ### Bug Fixes - - Make a `nearest` range anchor one point, and drop a `drop` range anchor, when one update deletes all of its text across a mark change, such as from plain into bold text, so a letter typed there later stays outside the range. ([`9e5dcae`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9e5dcae01c83cf9396ec9c43a8a0c86133d62dbc)) - Fix ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, with or without Shift, which spent one press on the edge between two text runs of a block, such as plain text beside bold or suggested text. One press now moves one character. ([`2ba256d`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/2ba256de28af7e3686b127b56311cf5a30eaf807)) - Keep pending DOM selection changes when late programmatic selection syncs or caret repairs run. ([`b4b84ec`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/b4b84ecbe1902bd8587b96062ef05a29def6a000)) - Fix accepting one of an author's two suggested line joins blocking: each join, and each line break with text between it and the next, is its own card and decides alone ([`3b41f03`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/3b41f03bef9f0b15a0e722c8736000be584136ba)) - Speed up accepting and rejecting a suggestion in an editor whose elements store generated ids, such as one with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`. A decision resolves only the blocks its change touches instead of the whole document. ([`c58baad`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/c58baadeeaa08598fb961e9b6452526e789b5972)) - Fix a decision that returned `blocked` until another author's change was decided when it emptied a line or a quote, unwrapped a quote, or landed a join on a line it removed. The decision now applies, and the other author's change stays pending on what is left. For example, accepting the deletion of a line's text while another author struck the whole line leaves an empty line that the strike still decides, and a line built to keep a quote from being empty joins any insertion or deletion pending on that quote. A change also no longer waits on a change of the same author that the review shows as another card, such as a heading and the deletion of that line's text. Removing a piece of a link that another author split no longer waits on that split. One author's decisions still give the same result in every order. ([`b1c85dd`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/b1c85dd3fe8c2444239868c1a58f965b4cc2a13c)) - Accept another author's whole pending deletion when an Editing write replaces a selection that holds it, in an editor with no shared room or Yjs binding, so Reject all no longer restores text the write removed and one Undo restores both ([`c49aae2`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/c49aae2334fa1fa096a71fad4ea2f9a1b51aa4e0)) - Keep a block that a move in Editing carries, such as a paragraph dragged below the next one with the authored plugin, as the same block instead of a deleted copy and a new one. A range anchor inside it, such as a comment thread's text, stays on its text, and other authors' pending suggestions in the block keep their ids. A move in the same command as another edit records as before. ([`83dc0fe`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/83dc0fe71961c8b5f33e17b1e4f31717d3fc876c)) - Fix typing in a line whose last live text was just deleted while another author's deletion of that line is pending. The letter now lands on that line instead of the end of the line before it, in Editing and Suggesting, and also when one update deletes and retypes the text. ([`5c03c44`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5c03c44802f2fbe421e638c1515f9d9a67dc71d7)) - - Fix `Escape` leaving a block selection in place. When no earlier handler takes the key, `Escape` leaves a caret at the end of the block the selection ends on, or right after a selected image or other object. A read-only editor keeps the selection. ([`5ce5f9f`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5ce5f9fdade94eb730704d974623596bc0504d78)) - Undo history no longer reads a document's whole top-level list when it merges an update into the undo step before it. In a document of 10,000 paragraphs, each merged keystroke read all 10,000 before this change and reads none now. ([`89ff464`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/89ff464a7e6a2789d2539dbafc765db79984cdf5)) - Undo history now merges an update that writes only properties of several nodes into the step before it inside the merge window. Both updates must write the same properties on the same nodes, in one root or across several. An update on one node keeps merging whatever properties it writes. Two updates in one composition that write properties across several roots merge only when they touch the same roots. A `new-batch` update still starts its own step. ([`9d8f6eb`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9d8f6eb69c1559db6e469176932459b42d5a1639)) - - Fix character transpose, the `insertTranspose` input, leaving the text unchanged in a mounted editor. ([`5745de8`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5745de862d185d1409b4ff2b7e4515d473f1ad47)) - Fix a node inserted into a line that a suggested deletion emptied landing beside that line, which left an extra empty line and kept the inserted node after Reject all ([`4132cf0`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/4132cf0cf5eb218f6ce21870056ac78f416eda6c)) - - In an editor whose elements store ids, give each element a load finds without an id a `fill.` id, so every editor that loads one document holds the same ids. A repeated id stays on its first element. `createEditor` with an `initialValue` no longer throws on an element without an id, and a loaded element under Plate's `ElementIdPlugin` gets a `fill.` id instead of an `element-` id. ([`e362966`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/e3629669d926514f2e55d0928e9816bcd0e9416f)) - Fix a suggested paste that adds a block after the paragraph it pastes over, in a document that already holds a suggestion. The added block now shows as inserted, and rejecting the suggestion removes it. Before, a streamed AI answer that opened a code block left an empty code block behind. ([`5f89a38`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5f89a38508701888ff6e9cb2797e1aac00e1849c)) - - Fix a paste of whole blocks into an empty block of the same type replacing that block, so a paste rule that remembered the line lost it. A YouTube or other provider link copied with a space before or after it, or as HTML in a paragraph, and pasted on an empty line now becomes a media embed under `MediaEmbedRules.autoEmbed({ variant: 'paste' })`. A heading or other block of another type still replaces the empty block. ([`e12ef78`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/e12ef78d733cdbc5a5ae8663fc8f4afbab22b050)) - In an editor whose elements store ids, such as with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`, insert pasted lines as an editor without ids does. The paste replaced a piece of the line, so undoing it after a collaborator's concurrent move could drop the letters they typed. ([`a47c979`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/a47c979a66f3d80b970717cb58c59b9b298853ed)) - Fix a crash when a view switches to the accepted preview after an undo that rebuilds the whole preview, such as undoing Accept all after a struck word was dragged. The preview now shows the accepted text. ([`8578908`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/857890880f84ac8e3c542a6e02ff420308038b26)) - Preserve replaced stored nodes when rebuilding an authored preview root so root owners keep their new keys and placement metadata. ([`5ac5638`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5ac5638e3af22d4ee90578f0eeeb7634747b5bd9)) - Keep text typed beside a concurrently removed inline element on its own line when rebasing document changes ([`45a1db3`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/45a1db35eeb97c64ca259f74e8d8e47beae3f6c3)) - In an editor whose elements store ids, such as with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`, refuse to load a document whose element id is an empty string, a number or an object. The load throws an `EditorSchemaValidationError` instead of keeping or replacing the id. ([`5ac62f7`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5ac62f7dbde559baa5fac4da8cadb148f0b5b14d)) - Fix rejecting a suggested line break that dropped another author's pending format on the emptied line, such as an alignment or a heading. The format now stays pending on the line that remains, and accepting or rejecting it works as before. ([`f234c5b`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/f234c5b179e08d3b08a711830b1c5eb0621013f9)) - Keep element ids when content is replaced ([`6ff3575`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/6ff35759331cd592ebd98041661867452cd38ecf)) - In an editor whose elements store ids, `tx.value.replace`, `tx.nodes.replace` and `tx.nodes.replaceChildren` give each incoming element without an id the id of the old element it replaces. Elements pair by equal content, in order, then by order between those pairs. Replacing a document with equal content keeps every id and records no change. - An id an incoming element already holds stays on that element. An element with no counterpart gets a new id. - - Keep a heading that became the required title when a schema migration runs in the same update, instead of adding an empty title above it ([`d8c1a41`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/d8c1a41975443dbdbc40ba22ecd976beff7086a0)) - Keep the id of a required title that an update rebuilds, in an editor whose elements all hold ids - - Keep the target of `editor.api.dom.scrollIntoView` inside the part of the page a reader sees when the call passes no options. On a phone with the keyboard open, the target stops above the keyboard instead of behind it, on iOS Safari and on Android Chrome. The page's `scroll-padding` keeps the target clear of a fixed bar, and when the page cannot scroll far enough, the editor's scroll container scrolls the rest. An expanded selection scrolls to its focus end. ([`9eea162`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9eea162632049240dae787e8853f35c36357446c)) - Scroll to the caret's line when the caret sits on an empty line, where the browser reports an empty caret box. This also applies when the call passes options. - Fix undo after a run of Backspace or Delete in Suggesting mode, which took back one struck character per step. The run now undoes in one step, as it does in Editing. ([`612328a`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/612328a1935c069a5d2f563ad10fe4fc6837f07e)) - Land struck text dragged in Suggesting as the mover's insertion, with its old place still struck, so accepting everything keeps the moved text at the drop ([`90d380b`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/90d380b76ce972b8d86579434934c57cff3682b2)) - Fix the sync room refusing a suggester's undo of their own withdrawal when the undo puts back another author's pending change. The room now takes back the writer's own entry at suggest access too, as long as the access the writer holds now still covers that entry, so a writer whose access was lowered cannot undo what only the old access let them write. ([`a7b6c57`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/a7b6c5723a163cc74c1dd13a9db33d380b6fc6be)) - Accept a collaborator's honest edits beside a suggestion in a sync room whose editors store element ids, such as with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`. The room refused an edit, its undo or redo, an accept and a withdrawal that stored a spare line, and held back for review a decision that crossed a collaborator's concurrent change, such as a suggested wrap or unwrap. Such a decision also dropped the spare line the collaborator's change stored, and lost the collaborator's suggested unwrap of the quote that held the decided line. Accepting a suggested delete across lines that empties the first line now keeps the id that the same delete keeps in a plain editor. ([`cb58319`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/cb58319cfe4594f476d5df0a4b19cc508e0557af)) - Drop the spare blocks an author's suggestion stored once that author takes the suggestion back, such as with a Backspace over a suggested Enter, so the document's review marks and `records` keep no spare for a change that is no longer pending. ([`3699047`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/36990472acf4298e2b69cc8bb617efa3b1267dc8)) - Fix typing inside struck text landing after the pending deletion: the letter now lands at the caret and splits the deletion around it, as an input method already did ([`0f10367`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/0f10367e6b1e44adb49c55d8c5c354019499ef3c)) - Fix a letter typed inside a struck line that another author's deletion joined into the line before landing at the end of that line: it now lands at the caret ([`5a07fe3`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5a07fe364ea8d5c2d89ba109c2e298967ac67abe)) - In an editor whose elements store ids, such as with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`, undo after a collaborator moves or deletes a line as an editor without ids does. After an Enter at a line's start, the undo could skip a step, drop the letters the collaborator typed or give back the wrong lines. ([`88fa2bb`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/88fa2bb55661aa8a09ebffee2775a77529b5c9d6)) - - Move focus to the view that made a step when an undo or redo key in another view of the same `Editable` replays it, such as Mod+Z in the page after typing in a synced block's second copy. The caret goes back to where it was before that typing. Focus stays where the key was pressed when that view is gone, hidden or read-only, or when the step's selection ran from one view into another. It also stays when either view renders in a slot that passes `nodeSelectionFocus`. A step whose plugin history effect settles after the replay, such as creating a comment thread, also leaves focus where the key was pressed. ([`d1acacc`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/d1acacce0887f53677d36ec655e4333ab204b847)) - Keep focus in a focused external control when its undo or redo changes a root that another view shows, such as a synced block's copy. When the undo takes back typing in a second external control, focus still moves into that control. - Keep the caret in a view where an undo or redo key was pressed when the step was made in another root. After undoing a Delete that the page made across into one synced copy, a Delete in another copy now edits that copy instead of the first one. - Keep the caret in the editable that a focus handler moves focus into, instead of moving it back to the editable that received focus first. - Keep the letters a collaborator typed when you undo a change of yours that crossed theirs, in an editor whose elements store ids, such as one with Plate's `ElementIdPlugin`. ([`ee98035`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/ee98035b92c89077b7b9940bcb8e3f8131ad0195)) - - Fix undo focusing another copy of a shared content root instead of the copy the caret left, when the undo gives that root back to a block, as undoing Unsync of a synced block does. ([`533646d`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/533646d922a0c69eb15e6e1501e0db7f5d0221b9)) [`CHANGELOG`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/5348) · [`v54.0.0-beta.5...v54.0.0-beta.6`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/compare/platejs%4054.0.0-beta.5...platejs%4054.0.0-beta.6) · By [@zbeyens](https://github.com/zbeyens), [@felixfeng33](https://github.com/felixfeng33)
title: v54.0.0-beta.6

`platejs`

### Bug Fixes

-   - Move a comment thread with its text when a drag moves all of that text, and back again on undo. A drag of part of the text leaves the thread on the part that stays. Undoing a drag and the thread's creation, then redoing both, puts the thread back on its text. ([`dee395d`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/dee395d68e25980340ce470257e16c1d37486ac5))

-   - Add `fillsField(field, value)` to `platejs/field` to check whether a value fills a field. `required`, the `filled` and `blank` conditions and the refusal of an answer on a skipped field all use it. A checkbox fills only when ticked. A text or signature answer needs a character other than whitespace. Any other field needs a value of its kind. ([`dca432b`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/dca432b402ecaf554b5e662415c3966788e8051e))

-   - Fix the ink layer holding the outline of each removed pen mark in memory while undo history can still restore that mark ([`d2af1ef`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/d2af1efb9783ba40aa5d8ef856eeb42c9c462368))

-   - Fix Markdown copied from VS Code pasting as a Markdown code block; it now pastes as headings, lists and marks ([`4081ba8`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/4081ba8baae622b170ea68fb3666a43753947942))
  - Paste code copied from VS Code as a code block at the caret, replacing an empty block, instead of after the current block
  - Paste text copied from a plain-text file in VS Code as plain text instead of a code block

`plitejs`

### Bug Fixes

-   - Keep a range anchor made with `deletion: 'nearest'` on its text when a drag moves all of that text within one root, instead of leaving it collapsed where the text was. Undo and redo move it back and forth. A drag of part of the range leaves the anchor on the part that stays, unless the drop rebuilds the block that holds that part. A Suggesting move keeps the anchor on the struck original until the move is decided. A copy, a drag into another editor or root and an editor bound to Yjs or `plitejs/sync` map the range as before. ([`dee395d`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/dee395d68e25980340ce470257e16c1d37486ac5))

`@platejs/test`

### Bug Fixes

-   - Fix `clipboard.pasteText` and `clipboard.pasteHtml` in `@platejs/test/playwright` to pass a paste that a later commit follows, such as a paste rule's, and to fail a paste that landed in another editor root. Use `@platejs/test` with the `platejs` release of the same version. ([`8bee987`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/8bee9872bddd958a78546c7f723294abf3f9d123))

content:
`platejs`

### Bug Fixes

-   - Fix `BlockPlaceholderPlugin` drawing its placeholder on top of the editor `placeholder` when the editor holds only an empty list item. Only the editor placeholder shows there now, and an editor without a `placeholder` still shows the block placeholder on that item. ([`3a568a1`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/3a568a1a718270551a0585ee86b0c2d8e2145272))

-   - Add `exportPicture({ format, kit })` to `useBoardActions()` in `platejs/board/react`. It draws the board, or the selected shapes and frames, as a PNG or an SVG with the static plugins in `kit`, which may be a promise such as a dynamic import. `platejs`

### Bug Fixes

-   - Fix Backspace or Delete that empties a heading turning it into a paragraph. The empty heading stays, and the next Backspace turns it into a paragraph. ([`24651f9`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/24651f9a8b2b18aa4c688372f5439939140c77d2))
  - Fix Turn into Quote, the blockquote shortcut and `editor.plugin(BlockquotePlugin).update.wrap()` putting each selected block in its own blockquote. Adjacent selected blocks now share one blockquote.

-   - Fix the AI menu's first edit suggestion replacing the old selected text, and leaving stray characters, when you typed inside the selection after sending the request ([`c28d5ad`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/c28d5adcbac04d8bc5866e9556f2089fef3620e3))

-   - Keep `AIChatPlugin`'s preview and pending proposal when a transaction guard refuses its write. `accept`, `insertBelow` and `replaceSelection` close the session only once their write commits. ([`5716f93`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5716f93ccf30dd1cbefc9d523947ca7bcb7716b8))
  - Return `{ status: 'invalid' }` from `hide`, `reset`, `show`, `submit` and `reload`, and keep the session, when a guard refuses discarding the pending proposal.
  - Keep a streamed proposal when a guard refuses a chunk, and add the next chunk to the same undo step.

-   - Paste text or a link onto a focused board to add it as a selected note at the pointer, or at the view's center when the pointer is off the board. One undo removes it. ([`0fe05e3`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/0fe05e37d756fc10b2a2465de1fb823b64e4a876))
  - Paste or drop picture files onto a board to upload them as image shapes, in a row centered on the pointer or the drop point.
  - Upload the file of a picture copied from a web page when its link does not load, so the picture still lands on the board.
  - Add `upload(files)` to `useBoardActions()` to upload picture files, such as ones from a toolbar's file picker. Read `takesPictureFiles` through `useBoardView` to disable that button on a board that takes no picture files.
  - Add `fitsAfter(key)` to the upload plugin's API to ask whether another file's placeholder fits after an upload placeholder, such as before a file picker opens for several files.

-   - Fix board pen lines, geo shapes and notes whose type an app renames through `schema.override`. They now draw, erase, take the toolbar's styles and get announced like shapes of the default type. ([`75b505a`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/75b505a6a29c0e91cfdf08b2a65b126dd5a5cc2c))

-   - Add `read.board.strokePath(id)`, which returns the SVG path a board draws for a pen line, or `null` when `id` names no pen line. It needs no mounted board. ([`83517ee`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/83517ee62917c69f51a3c71da24629295e06862b))
  - Move `BoardStrokePath` from `platejs/board/react` to `platejs/board`. Import it from `platejs/board`.

-   - Add a `caret` plugin slot, rendered after the Editable, for UI that follows the caret. Inside it, `useEditor()` and the `editableRef` prop answer for the view that holds the caret, such as a board note, so a floating toolbar in this slot follows the caret into the note. ([`972c50f`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/972c50f6006c6681013def2d1d5b43e807e019a2))
  - Remove `EditorSelectionView` and the `useSelectionView` hook from `platejs/react`.

  **Migration:** Drop the `<EditorSelectionView>` wrapper. Move UI that used it inside an editing area, such as a floating toolbar, from `afterEditable` to the `caret` slot:

  ```tsx
  const FloatingToolbarPlugin = definePlugin('floatingToolbar', {
    slots: { caret: () => <FloatingToolbar /> },
  });
  ```

-   - Keep a code fence's info string after its language, such as `title="a.ts" {3-5}`, as the code block's `meta` through Markdown and HTML import and export ([`f7fa388`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/f7fa388cfbdc2cf18d132c8f71e6074d2174dc7c))

-   - Fix a CodeMirror code block dropping the next keystroke, paste, cut or drop when the editor resets its text during an input method composition, such as after a refused edit or a collaborator's change. ([`eff0999`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/eff0999e8ba281964882aa5f776c7fc04d0f68c1))
  - Keep a CodeMirror code block's caret where the editor puts it when the editor resets its text.
  - Fix a CodeMirror code block turning into a paragraph in WebKit browsers when an input method empties it.

-   - Fix Enter in the empty last body line of an open Details moving the caret into the block after it. Enter now adds an empty paragraph right after the Details and puts the caret there. ([`9d460d1`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9d460d1776362a155e087a674fcdca24bd5c6021))

-   - Report `condition-loop` on each field of a loop of conditions, such as A naming B while B names A, and refuse an `update` whose condition would close one. ([`8883a26`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/8883a26aa151182dc884f24a9818ff1c3f2e5272))
  - Refuse a `fieldId` in the settings of `insert` or the patch of `update`.
  - Check a condition that names its own field against the kind the same `update` sets.
  - List the page's fields in `read.fields()` from a board note's view, in reading order.

-   - Add `fillRole` to `BaseFieldPlugin`'s state. While it is set, the editor refuses every local change except a fitting or cleared value on that role's fields, and undo or redo returns `blocked` at a step that changed anything else. ([`839996e`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/839996e5e21a0309f9c079602d03d8a9c0faece4))
  - Start a new undo step when a field write's role differs from the step before it, so a fill never shares an undo step with an author's edit.
  - Refuse the whole update instead of throwing when, while a fill role is set, `update` names a field that no longer exists or a value that no longer fits it.

- Add `editor.plugin(BaseHeadingPlugin).read.canSetLevel(level)`, which answers whether `setLevel(level)` can apply to every selected block. A menu can disable a heading level the caret's parent cannot hold. ([`5c0aff5`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/5c0aff5d261697b1e237946af31fc5230ad72247))

- Fix a hydration mismatch in a control that reads `useEditorFocused()` and hydrates after its editor took focus, such as a toolbar behind `Suspense` beside an `EditorContent` with `autoFocus` ([`868638a`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/868638ac2fe89fc0d7988d0e53db2cda6245c9a5))

- Replace `InkLayer` with `InkContent`, which mounts as the ink plugin's `wrapContent` slot. In development, it throws when anything sits between the Editable and the ink layer, such as a toolbar the layer would cover. ([`7a0e402`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/7a0e402a17374c80d3c16537a6c2988ffb28949f))

  **Migration:** Replace the `wrapContent` slot that rendered `<InkLayer sign={Sign} />` after its children with `wrapContent: (props) => <InkContent {...props} sign={Sign} />`.

- Keep a pen mark's sign where its block stood when the block is deleted while the mark is being drawn, here or by a collaborator, however many other edits come before the mark saves ([`405fd82`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/405fd82c363be236baba67a96033653dd735683b))

- Save pen marks in a packed format about half the size. Marks saved by 54.0.0-beta.2 still read, but an app still on 54.0.0-beta.2 shows none of the marks this version saves ([`0938c3d`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/0938c3d8da13cf94bf8e7bcee15731b73f0ca2a2))

- Fix ink marks left off their words after a style change moves the words without resizing the paragraph. Marks now place again a quarter second after the last edit, layout change or scroll ([`dffae16`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/dffae16cdf7e17595560985bbbca0982b69e5ecd))

- Speed up typing, drawing, scrolling and deleting many marked blocks in documents with many ink marks. `read.marks()` keeps each unchanged mark's object between reads. ([`7bc3175`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/7bc3175013df3e0a08e41c5852c3014dcea1043f))

- Leave out the ink paragraph snapshots no mark points at when an editor opens a saved document, so a removed mark's words leave the file at its next save. Snapshots saved by 54.0.0-beta.2 stay, so an app still on beta.2 can undo back to its own marks. ([`6d7c412`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/6d7c41251cab3bd08f73fc5a1f40372c7cd238a8))

-   - Keep a Markdown file's leading YAML or TOML front matter. `editor.api.markdown.parse` stores it at `meta['markdown.frontmatter']` instead of reading it as a rule and a heading, `serialize` writes it back first, and `getMarkdownFrontmatter` from `platejs/markdown` reads it ([`78987a9`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/78987a92e20e96972625f5e3a81af7a182fc1ee5))
  - Fail `serialize` under the reject policy with `markdown-frontmatter-omitted` when it cannot write the stored front matter back. Under `lossPolicy: 'allow'` it writes the file without the block and warns
  - Start a serialized file with a line ending when its body would otherwise read back as front matter, such as two `---` rules

-   - Style an unclosed bold, italic or strikethrough run in a `partial` `parse`, `parseSlice` or `parseInline` preview as it will read once it closes, and hide up to three trailing `*`, `_`, `~` or `\` characters until the next chunk decides them. A later chunk can take back styling a preview showed ([`2ad50b0`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/2ad50b014c94356114aa2e42c399bedac192ccf9))

-   - Fix Markdown that read back differently after a save: code spans with line endings or edge spaces, emphasis around a link, nested emphasis, a bare URL right after text and an empty list item before a nested ordered list ([`824887f`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/824887fff62da30e8297a1d15eef8ee39e9f8c0e))
  - Fix streamed Markdown parses that missed a link definition inside a quote or a list item

-   - Fix `parseSlice` with `previous` returning a different preview than a fresh parse for streamed Markdown that holds, among others, no-break spaces in a blank line, a math block opened with more than two dollars, a link definition with an escaped bracket, a byte order mark or a lone CR line ending ([`a1af219`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/a1af219edc003dcbced0eeedb205f92c55616e4b))

-   - Make `useEditor()` outside every editing area of an `EditorRoot`, such as in a fixed toolbar, return the editor of the root that holds the caret. A toolbar command such as `editor.plugin(BoldPlugin).update.toggle()` then changes a board's note while the caret is in it. With nothing selected it returns the editor of the primary root. `useEditorSelector`, `useEditorReadOnly`, `useEditorFocused` and the other hooks that read that editor follow it too, and a component whose selected value stays equal no longer renders when the caret moves. ([`9fc3e9a`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9fc3e9a4ac72ae81db336ef4642da2306729dbd7))
  - Make `useEditorHistory()` with no `editor` or `root` undo and redo the editor `useEditor()` returns. It no longer needs an `EditorRoot` around it.

  ```tsx
  function Lock() {
    const editor = useEditor();

    return (
      <button onClick={() => setEditorReadOnly(editor, true)}>Lock</button>
    );
  }

  <EditorRoot editor={editor}>
    <EditorContainer>
      <Lock />
      <EditorContent />
    </EditorContainer>
  </EditorRoot>;
  ```

- Give each tile of a table paste, and each cell of a table fill, its own copy of an element another element references, such as a field. -   - Add `admit` and `fill` to the upload plugin's update API. A plugin with its own insert, such as one that wraps each file's placeholder in a container, checks a batch with `admit`, inserts the placeholders it returns and gives each file its placeholder with `fill`. ([`9b218c9`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/9b218c9cb6c60809c4f6de75f51b4c6e2df3f682))

-   - Report an unsupported file type first when a file of another kind is picked for an upload placeholder, before the size and configuration checks. ([`0db21cf`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/commit/0db21cf93a87eb3fc1ed40d4c2723cefd4f9f669))
  - Fix an upload placeholder's submit sending its file twice, losing it or sending an older file when its transaction spec replays, another commit or a Cancel comes first, or a newer submit overtakes it.

`@platejs/autoformat`

### Breaking Changes

- Deprecate `@platejs/autoformat`. Markdown shortcuts and text substitutions are now authored as `inputRules` on each feature plugin, and `AutoformatPlugin` remains only as an inert compatibility export. ([#4941](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/4941))

    **Migration:**

    1.  Remove `AutoformatPlugin` from your plugins and replace `@platejs/autoformat` after migrating rules.
    2.  Replace each old `AutoformatRule` with the matching rule factory on the plugin that owns the feature. See the table below.
    3.  Replace symbol substitutions (arrows, fractions, smart quotes, legal, math operators) with `createTextSubstitutionInputRule` registered on a local `createBasePlugin`.
    4.  Replace `rules[].query` with `enabled` on the rule factory call. Replace the global code-block guard with a per-plugin `enabled` check.
    5.  Drop `enableUndoOnDelete` — undo-on-delete is the built-in behavior.
    6.  Replace custom `AutoformatRule` definitions with `createRuleFactory` from `platejs`.

    ```tsx
    // Before
    import { AutoformatPlugin } from "@platejs/autoformat";

    const editor = createPlateEditor({
      plugins: [
        AutoformatPlugin.configure({
          options: {
            enableUndoOnDelete: true,
            rules: [
              { match: "# ", mode: "block", type: KEYS.h1 },
              { match: "**", mode: "mark", type: KEYS.bold },
              {
                match: "* ",
                mode: "block",
                type: "list",
                format: (editor) =>
                  toggleList(editor, { listStyleType: KEYS.ul }),
              },
            ],
          },
        }),
      ],
    });

    // After
    import { BoldRules } from "@platejs/basic-nodes";
    import { BoldPlugin } from "@platejs/basic-nodes/react";
    import { HeadingRules } from "@platejs/basic-nodes";
    import { H1Plugin } from "@platejs/basic-nodes/react";
    import { BulletedListRules } from "@platejs/list";
    import { ListPlugin } from "@platejs/list/react";

    const editor = createPlateEditor({
      plugins: [
        H1Plugin.configure({ inputRules: [HeadingRules.markdown()] }),
        BoldPlugin.configure({
          inputRules: [BoldRules.markdown({ variant: "*" })],
        }),
        ListPlugin.configure({
          inputRules: [BulletedListRules.markdown({ variant: "-" })],
        }),
      ],
    });
    ```

    ### Rule Map

    #### Basic blocks — `@platejs/basic-nodes`

    | Old rule                                                         | New rule                                                                                                                                           |
    | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
    | `{ match: '# '..'###### ', mode: 'block', type: KEYS.h1..h6 }`   | `HxPlugin.configure({ inputRules: [HeadingRules.markdown()] })` — register on each `H1Plugin`..`H6Plugin`                                          |
    | `{ match: '> ', mode: 'block', type: KEYS.blockquote }`          | `BlockquotePlugin.configure({ inputRules: [BlockquoteRules.markdown()] })`                                                                         |
    | `{ match: ['---', '—-', '___ '], mode: 'block', type: KEYS.hr }` | `HorizontalRulePlugin.configure({ inputRules: [HorizontalRuleRules.markdown({ variant: '-' }), HorizontalRuleRules.markdown({ variant: '_' })] })` |

    #### Basic marks — `@platejs/basic-nodes`

    | Old rule                                                             | New rule                                                      | Owning plugin         |
    | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------- |
    | `{ match: '**', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.bold }`                     | `BoldRules.markdown({ variant: '*' })`                        | `BoldPlugin`          |
    | `{ match: '__', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.underline }`                | `UnderlineRules.markdown()`                                   | `UnderlinePlugin`     |
    | `{ match: '*', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.italic }`                    | `ItalicRules.markdown({ variant: '*' })`                      | `ItalicPlugin`        |
    | `{ match: '_', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.italic }`                    | `ItalicRules.markdown({ variant: '_' })`                      | `ItalicPlugin`        |
    | ``{ match: '`', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.code }``                    | `CodeRules.markdown()`                                        | `CodePlugin`          |
    | `{ match: '~~', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.strikethrough }`            | `StrikethroughRules.markdown()`                               | `StrikethroughPlugin` |
    | `{ match: '~', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.sub }`                       | `SubscriptRules.markdown()`                                   | `SubscriptPlugin`     |
    | `{ match: '^', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.sup }`                       | `SuperscriptRules.markdown()`                                 | `SuperscriptPlugin`   |
    | `{ match: '==', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.highlight }`                | `HighlightRules.markdown({ variant: '==' })`                  | `HighlightPlugin`     |
    | `{ match: '≡', mode: 'mark', type: KEYS.highlight }`                 | `HighlightRules.markdown({ variant: '≡' })`                   | `HighlightPlugin`     |
    | `{ match: '***', mode: 'mark', type: [bold, italic] }`               | `MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: 'boldItalic' })`          | `BoldPlugin`          |
    | `{ match: '__*', mode: 'mark', type: [underline, italic] }`          | `MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: 'italicUnderline' })`     | `BoldPlugin`          |
    | `{ match: '__**', mode: 'mark', type: [underline, bold] }`           | `MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: 'boldUnderline' })`       | `BoldPlugin`          |
    | `{ match: '___***', mode: 'mark', type: [underline, bold, italic] }` | `MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: 'boldItalicUnderline' })` | `BoldPlugin`          |

    Register each family on its owning plugin:

    ```tsx
    BoldPlugin.configure({
      inputRules: [
        BoldRules.markdown({ variant: "*" }),
        BoldRules.markdown({ variant: "_" }),
        MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: "boldItalic" }),
        MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: "boldUnderline" }),
        MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: "boldItalicUnderline" }),
        MarkComboRules.markdown({ variant: "italicUnderline" }),
      ],
    });
    ```

    #### Code block — `@platejs/code-block`

    | Old rule                                                                                    | New rule                                                                                |
    | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
    | ````{ match: '```', mode: 'block', type: KEYS.codeBlock, format: insertEmptyCodeBlock }```` | `CodeBlockPlugin.configure({ inputRules: [CodeBlockRules.markdown({ on: 'match' })] })` |

    | Old rule                                                                                                   | New rule                                                                                       |
    | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
    | `{ match: ['- ', '* '], mode: 'block', format: toggleList(..., { listStyleType: KEYS.ul }) }`              | `BulletedListRules.markdown({ variant: '-' })`, `BulletedListRules.markdown({ variant: '*' })` |
    | `{ match: /^\d+\.$ \|^\d+\)$ /, matchByRegex: true, format: toggleList(..., { listStyleType: KEYS.ol }) }` | `OrderedListRules.markdown({ variant: '.' })`, `OrderedListRules.markdown({ variant: ')' })`   |
    | `{ match: '[] ', mode: 'block', format: toggleList(..., { listStyleType: KEYS.listTodo }) }`               | `TaskListRules.markdown({ checked: false })`                                                   |
    | `{ match: '[x] ', mode: 'block', format: toggleList + setNodes({ checked: true }) }`                       | `TaskListRules.markdown({ checked: true })`                                                    |

    ```tsx
    ListPlugin.configure({
      inputRules: [
        BulletedListRules.markdown({ variant: "-" }),
        BulletedListRules.markdown({ variant: "*" }),
        OrderedListRules.markdown({ variant: "." }),
        OrderedListRules.markdown({ variant: ")" }),
        TaskListRules.markdown({ checked: false }),
        TaskListRules.markdown({ checked: true }),
      ],
    });
    ```

    #### Math — `@platejs/math`

    | Old rule               | New rule                                                                                         |
    | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
    | Inline equation `$…$`  | `InlineEquationPlugin.configure({ inputRules: [MathRules.markdown({ variant: '$' })] })`         |
    | Block equation `$$…$$` | `EquationPlugin.configure({ inputRules: [MathRules.markdown({ on: 'break', variant: '$$' })] })` |

    #### Link — `@platejs/link`

    | Old behavior           | New rule                                   |
    | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
    | `[text](url)` markdown | `LinkRules.markdown()`                     |
    | Autolink on paste      | `LinkRules.autolink({ variant: 'paste' })` |
    | Autolink on space      | `LinkRules.autolink({ variant: 'space' })` |
    | Autolink on Enter      | `LinkRules.autolink({ variant: 'break' })` |

    ```tsx
    LinkPlugin.configure({
      inputRules: [
        LinkRules.markdown(),
        LinkRules.autolink({ variant: "paste" }),
        LinkRules.autolink({ variant: "space" }),
        LinkRules.autolink({ variant: "break" }),
      ],
    });
    ```

    #### Text substitutions (arrows, fractions, legal, math operators, smart quotes)

    Move these to a local `createBasePlugin` with `createTextSubstitutionInputRule`:

    ```tsx
    import {
      createBasePlugin,
      createTextSubstitutionInputRule,
      KEYS,
    } from "platejs";

    const isTextSubstitutionBlocked = (editor) =>
      editor.api.some({ match: { type: [editor.getType(KEYS.codeBlock)] } });

    const ShortcutsPlugin = createBasePlugin({
      key: "shortcuts",
      inputRules: [
        createTextSubstitutionInputRule({
          enabled: ({ editor }) => !isTextSubstitutionBlocked(editor),
          patterns: [
            { format: "→", match: "->" },
            { format: "⇒", match: "=>" },
            { format: "½", match: "1/2" },
            { format: "™", match: ["(tm)", "(TM)"] },
            { format: ["“", "”"], match: '"' },
          ],
        }),
      ],
    });
    ```

    Each pattern set is just data — `autoformatArrow`, `autoformatLegal`, `autoformatMath`, `autoformatPunctuation`, `autoformatSmartQuotes`, and `autoformatLegalHtml` from the old package map 1:1 onto `patterns` arrays. `AutoformatKit` in the Plate registry is pre-built with all of them.

    #### Custom rules

    Old `AutoformatRule` objects have no direct replacement. Build a rule family with `createRuleFactory`:

    ```tsx
    import { createRuleFactory } from "platejs";

    const MyRules = {
      markdown: createRuleFactory({
        type: "blockMatch",
        match: "!! ",
        format: "my-block",
      }),
    };

    MyPlugin.configure({ inputRules: [MyRules.markdown()] });
    ```

    ### Option removals

    -   `enableUndoOnDelete` — removed. Backspace on a rule-inserted node restores the source text by default.
    -   `rules[].query` — replaced by `enabled` on the rule factory call.
    -   `rules[].preFormat` / `rules[].format` — replaced by rule-family `format` and `resolve` callbacks inside `createRuleFactory`.
    -   `rules[].trigger` — rule families set their own trigger. Override it with the `trigger` option on a custom `createRuleFactory` call.

    See the [Autoformat](/docs/autoformat) doc for the kit path and the [Plugin Input Rules](/docs/plugin-input-rules) guide for the full runtime.

    ```tsx
      children: [
        { type: 'p', children: [{ text: 'Quote' }] },
        { type: 'p', children: [{ text: 'Next line' }] },

    }
    ```

### Breaking Changes

- Added **AI Comment** functionality to provide AI-powered text feedback and suggestions.And upgrade to AI SDK 5. ([#4587](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/4587))

    ### New Features:

    -   **AI Comment Integration**: New utilities for AI-generated comments on selected text

        -   `aiCommentToRange()` - Convert AI comments to text ranges with proper block mapping
        -   `findTextRangeInBlock()` - Find text ranges within blocks for accurate comment positioning

    -   **Enhanced AI Chat**: Improved chat functionality with comment support

        -   New `toolName` property in chat helpers for tracking AI tools
        -   Support for AI comment prompts in chat submissions
        -   Added `mode`, `toolName` params to `submitAIChat`
        -   New `toolName` plugin option.

    -   **Text Matching**: Advanced text matching algorithms
        -   Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) algorithm for fuzzy text matching
        -   Support for multi-block text selection and comment ranges
        -   Accurate text position tracking across block boundaries

    ### Example:

    ```typescript
    // Convert AI comment to text range
    const range = aiCommentToRange(editor, {
      blockId: 'block-1',
      content: 'Selected text',
      comment: 'Consider adding more detail here',
    });
    ```

    -   `streamInsertChunk` has been moved from `@platejs/ai` to `@platejs/ai/react`.
    -   `getEditorPrompt` has been moved from `@platejs/ai/react` to `@platejs/ai`.
    -   `getMarkdown` has been moved from `@platejs/ai/react` to `@platejs/ai`.

### Features

- New editor DOM state fields available under `editor.dom`: ([#4327](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/4327))
    - `editor.dom.composing`: Boolean, true if the editor is currently composing text (e.g., during IME input).
    - `editor.dom.focused`: Boolean, true if the editor currently has focus.
    - `editor.dom.readOnly`: Boolean, true if the editor is in read-only mode. Passing the `readOnly` prop to `PlateContent` will sync its value to this state and to the `useEditorReadOnly` hook.
- New editor metadata fields:
    - `editor.meta.components` - stores the plugin components by key
- New hook `useEditorComposing`: Allows subscription to the editor's composing state (`editor.dom.composing`) outside of `PlateContent`.
- `createPlateEditor` and `usePlateEditor` now accept a `readOnly` option to initialize the editor in a read-only state. For dynamic read-only changes after initialization, continue to use the `readOnly` prop on the `<Plate>` or `<PlateContent>` component.
- New plugin field: `editOnly` (boolean or object).
    - When `true` or when specific properties are true in the object, Plate will disable certain plugin behaviors (handlers, rendering, injections) in read-only mode and re-enable them if the editor becomes editable.
    - By default, `render`, `handlers`, and `inject` are considered edit-only (`true`). `normalizeInitialValue` defaults to always active (`false`).
    - Example: `editOnly: { render: false, normalizeInitialValue: true }` would make rendering active always, but normalization only in edit mode.
- New plugin field: `render.as` (`keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap`).
    - Specifies the default HTML tag name to be used by `PlateElement` (default: `'div'`) or `PlateLeaf` (default: `'span'`) when rendering the node, but only if no custom `node.component` is provided for the plugin.
    - Example: `render: { as: 'h1' }` would make the plugin render its node as an `<h1>` tag by default without the need to provide a custom component.
- New plugin field: `node.isContainer` (boolean).
    - When `true`, indicates that the plugin's elements are primarily containers for other content.
- New plugin field: `node.isStrictSiblings` (boolean).
    - When `true`, indicates that the element enforces strict sibling type constraints and only allows specific siblings (e.g., `td` can only have `td` siblings, `column` can only have `column` siblings).
    - Used by `editor.tf.insertExitBreak` functionality to determine appropriate exit points in nested structures.
- New plugin field: `rules` (object).
    - Configures common editing behaviors declaratively instead of overriding editor methods. See documentation for more details.
    - `rules.break`: Controls Enter key behavior (`empty`, `default`, `emptyLineEnd`, `splitReset`)
    - `rules.delete`: Controls Backspace key behavior (`start`, `empty`)
    - `rules.merge`: Controls block merging behavior (`removeEmpty`)
    - `rules.normalize`: Controls normalization behavior (`removeEmpty`)
    - `rules.selection`: Controls cursor positioning behavior (`affinity`)
    - `rules.match`: Conditional rule application based on node properties
- Plugin shortcuts can now automatically leverage existing plugin transforms by specifying the transform name, in addition to custom handlers.
- New editor transform methods for keyboard handling:
    - `editor.tf.escape`: Handle Escape key events. Returns `true` if the event is handled.
    - `editor.tf.moveLine`: Handle ArrowDown and ArrowUp key events with `reverse` option for direction. Returns `true` if the event is handled.
    - `editor.tf.selectAll`: Handle Ctrl/Cmd+A key events for selecting all content. Returns `true` if the event is handled.
    - `editor.tf.tab`: Handle Tab and Shift+Tab key events with `reverse` option for Shift+Tab. Returns `true` if the event is handled.

`@udecode/plate-reset-node`

### Breaking Changes

- Package `@udecode/plate-reset-node` has been deprecated. Its functionality (e.g., `ResetNodePlugin`) is now exclusively configured using the `rules.break` and `rules.delete` options on plugin definitions. Migration: ([#4327](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/4327))

    -   Remove `@udecode/plate-reset-node` from your dependencies.
    -   Remove any usage of `ResetNodePlugin` from your project.
    -   Configure reset behaviors directly on the relevant plugins by defining `rules.break` and/or `rules.delete`.

    **Example: Resetting a Blockquote to a Paragraph**

    ```typescript
    ResetNodePlugin.configure({
      options: {
        rules: [
          {
            types: [BlockquotePlugin.key],
            defaultType: ParagraphPlugin.key,
            hotkey: 'Enter',
            predicate: (editor) =>
              editor.api.isEmpty(editor.selection, { block: true }),
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    // After
    BlockquotePlugin.configure({
      rules: {
        break: { empty: 'reset' },
        delete: { start: 'reset' },
      },
    });
    ```

    **For custom reset logic (previously `onReset`):**

    ```typescript
    // Before
    ResetNodePlugin.configure({
      options: {
        rules: [
          {
            types: [CodeBlockPlugin.key],
            defaultType: ParagraphPlugin.key,
            hotkey: 'Enter',
            predicate: isCodeBlockEmpty,
            onReset: unwrapCodeBlock,
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    // After
    CodeBlockPlugin.configure({
      rules: {
        delete: { empty: 'reset' },
      },
    }).overrideEditor(({ editor, tf: { resetBlock } }) => ({
      transforms: {
        resetBlock(options) {
          if (
            editor.api.block({
              at: options?.at,
              match: { type: editor.getType(CodeBlockPlugin.key) },
            })
          ) {
            unwrapCodeBlock(editor);
            return;
          }

          return resetBlock(options);
        },
      },
    }));
    ```

